outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. Forecast daily highs, corrected by -1.7 °C for the difference between the forecast service and the 30-year record, reach this place's 95th percentile for the time of year on 2 days in a row, and its 99th on at least one. That line is moved up 0.3 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 3 Nov: 29 °C against a usual worst of 27.4 °C. 4 Nov: 28.8 °C against a usual worst of 27.4 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-10-29, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Guatemala City, Guatemala, Guatemala, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
